purpose: Aesthetic memory index for DESIGNOSFORGE v2.0 DesignKernel routing, EnvArt CADMCP routing, FailureMemoryBank, and PromptPacketV2 case selection.

batches.sample_caption: Reference memory for an AIGC picturebook built around Chaoshan Yingge dance, Water Margin hero imagery, ancestral hall murals, and a child protagonist carrying a symbolic token. The transferable design value is a cultural-story engine: field-like setting, ritual object, mural awakening, hero sequence, group formation, and inheritance ending.
sample_positive_notes: heritage content becomes narrative action instead of static ornament
the child protagonist gives the cultural system an accessible emotional viewpoint
ancestral hall murals, ritual props, hero masks and group formation create a clear story loop
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the original article images or page layout as training targets
do not reduce Yingge culture to generic Chinese festival decoration
avoid listing historical heroes without a narrative function

batches.sample_caption: Close frontal product photo of a tall saturated purple retail shopping bag on a warm kraft paper background, black fabric handles, centered black vertical typography list on the side panel, lower text reading Chi VINTAGE, crisp folded paper base and strong shadowed side seam, fashion resale packaging mood.
sample_positive_notes: deep purple bag surface becomes the single anchor
vertical type column gives rhythm to the tall side panel
kraft background warms the saturated purple
sample_negative_notes: do not train third-party luxury brand names as reusable text
avoid making the bag surface muddy or underexposed
do not add extra props or retail clutter

batches.sample_caption: City or regional identity logo reference with a compact modular wordmark made from rounded square blocks, bright blue, green, orange, yellow and pink color units, simple geometric cutouts, bilingual Chinese and romanized naming, and generous white negative space. Shows horizontal and stacked logo lockups for a friendly public-place brand system.
sample_positive_notes: rounded modular blocks create a soft civic identity without decorative clutter
color units are bright but separated by a stable geometric grid
two lockup formats show scalable identity behavior
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the exact wordmark or city name
avoid candy-color chaos without block logic
do not add mascot illustrations or extra landmark icons

batches.sample_caption: University competition information-visualization board for intangible cultural heritage, deep purple background, luminous gold title, large ritual wheel and zodiac calendar anchor on the left, project introduction block, regional distribution maps, mask taxonomy, historical timeline, chart modules, circular deity mask cards, pattern references, and bottom cultural evolution timeline. The board is dense but organized by a strong radial anchor, framed modules, gold divider lines, and evidence categories.
sample_positive_notes: a single oversized ritual wheel creates authority and prevents the dense board from feeling scattered
gold linework, dark purple field, and cultural illustration inserts form a clear heritage-infovis mood
maps, timeline, taxonomy, chart and pattern references prove the topic through evidence rather than decoration
sample_negative_notes: do not copy watermark text or creator marks
do not generate random zodiac ornaments without a research category
avoid overfilling the whole board with equal-weight micro icons

batches.sample_caption: University discipline competition board for Culture China cultural tourism research, teal header with large Chinese research title, subtle illustrated Tianjin city background, project explanation block, extracted color palette swatches, four modular illustrated information-visualization panels about river transport, culture, city aesthetics and value analysis, plus a bottom application display strip with phone cases, booklets, posters, transit media and exhibition scenarios.
sample_positive_notes: strong separation between research title, project explanation, infovis panels and application display
teal academic header creates a consistent non-commercial competition identity
hand-drawn cultural tourism illustrations give regional warmth without losing board order
sample_negative_notes: do not copy or generate the large diagonal watermark as a design element
avoid turning dense illustrated sub-panels into uncontrolled clutter
do not treat this as a commercial campaign poster or product advertisement

batches.sample_caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for deterministic DXF inspection: run cad_health, inspect layer names and entity counts, audit the DXF, then translate walls, openings, columns, axes, text, dimensions and title block into a source-truth report before any board styling or image2 prompt.
sample_positive_notes: CAD inspection becomes the first design layer, not a back-office afterthought
semantic layer reports prevent pretty boards from hiding wrong plan topology
source truth can be converted into clean analysis overlays without redrawing the base plan
sample_negative_notes: do not beautify a plan before reading units, scale, walls, openings and dimensions
avoid copying layer 0 habits into the training target
do not let diagram arrows cover missing wall/opening errors

batches.sample_caption: Reference memory for extracting reusable poster language from a high-profile music award key visual. The transferable value is a method: identify the central metaphor, atmosphere, material texture, rhythm, typography hierarchy, content slots and replacement rules, then turn them into a clean GPT-image2 poster framework for new event themes.
sample_positive_notes: design-language extraction separates reusable grammar from copyrighted official visuals
a central metaphor gives the poster emotional coherence before typography and decoration
prompt slots make event name, award name, edition, brand mark and title replaceable without losing hierarchy
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the official Golden Melody Awards visual, brand assets or exact poster composition
do not treat an extracted prompt framework as permission to clone a source campaign
avoid generic AI poster gloss without a clear metaphor and text hierarchy

batches.sample_caption: Three-poster identity system for the Chinese Cultural Center of Milan, cream poster fields on a deep oxblood-brown presentation board, modular circular C-like symbols in cyan, orange-red, and pale yellow, bold stacked sans typography, Italian and English cultural-center naming, geometric grid composition, strong negative space, disciplined institutional visual identity.
sample_positive_notes: clear modular logo language across three poster variants
limited civic palette creates strong recognition
cream and oxblood fields keep contrast warm and cultural
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the exact institutional logo as a universal symbol
avoid adding decorative Chinese motifs or random brush textures
do not turn small footer text into pseudo-language blocks

batches.sample_caption: Portrait photography tutorial memory for planning expression, lighting, pose, lens choice and background separation before post-production. Use diffused or golden-hour light for gentle portraits, short-telephoto or shallow-depth setups when flattering facial proportion is important, and test lighting before the subject enters the scene.
sample_positive_notes: portrait quality starts before retouching: light, pose, expression and background must be coherent
soft or diffused light protects skin texture and lowers retouching burden
background separation supports a clear subject anchor
sample_negative_notes: do not rely on heavy retouching to repair bad light or confused pose
avoid harsh mixed lighting that makes skin color inconsistent
do not blur the background so much that scene identity disappears when context matters

batches.sample_caption: Reference memory for an AIGC picturebook based on a Qiang ethnic myth: a young protagonist leaves a cold village, follows a red bird, carries a white stone, crosses forest, snow and cliff challenges, confronts danger, reaches a sacred mountain, retrieves fire and returns warmth to the community.
sample_positive_notes: the story has a clear heroic journey that is easy to convert into storyboard beats
white stone, red bird, sacred mountain and fire seed create a compact symbolic system
the community problem and return-with-gift ending make the myth emotionally legible
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the original article images or long story text
do not flatten Qiang cultural material into generic fantasy China
avoid adding arbitrary monsters, temples or ornaments without a mythic function

batches.sample_caption: Competition exhibition board for The Waiting Machine, showing a public spatial installation render with light wood mechanical waterwheel-like structure, gray architectural interior, dark lattice ceiling, wood wall panel, human scale cutout figures, bold Chinese title 露骨的期待, English title The Waiting Machine, and a lower design concept text strip in a clean white board layout.
sample_positive_notes: strong opening board that combines project title, spatial render, and concept paragraph
installation is readable as a wood mechanical public device
human figures provide scale without dominating the scene
sample_negative_notes: do not overtrain cutout people style as required for all boards
avoid turning the dark lattice ceiling into random dirty visual noise
do not generate dense Chinese concept copy without verified text

batches.sample_caption: Reference memory for a graduation-design IP system that turns chemistry education into an Element Intelligence Agency universe. The opening system cover uses a custom experimental Chinese title, electric blue block geometry, playful element mascots and a lab scene to create an immediately recognizable science-communication identity.
sample_positive_notes: scientific concepts are personified into a coherent mascot system instead of decorative icons
the title, blue geometric block and lab scene create a clear first-viewport identity anchor
bold color and childlike energy are controlled by a manual-like presentation frame
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the original mascots, title lettering or scene composition
avoid making chemistry symbols into random cute stickers without a system role
do not let bright colors erase hierarchy or text legibility

batches.sample_caption: High-end Chinese black tea packaging, a single white cylindrical tea container with a warm bamboo lid, vertical red textured paper or fabric seal label, abstract black brand mark, dense small Chinese body text on the lower label, centered on a clean pale gray studio background with soft grounding shadow and restrained negative space.
sample_positive_notes: single dominant product anchor
large quiet background with controlled grain
red vertical label creates a clear hierarchy against white ceramic surface
sample_negative_notes: do not over-train the gray background grain as intentional decoration
do not invent extra seals, ornaments, tea leaves, or random cultural motifs
avoid pseudo-Chinese text; treat dense small copy as high-risk unless exact source text is supplied
